Question 20

Use a fundamental vector product to determine which of the following integrals gives the surface area generated when the curve x=zz is rotated by 2π radians about the z-axis for z∈[0,2].

a
2π∫02z+z4dz
b
2π∫02z31+zzdz
c
2π∫02zz+12z4dz
d
2π∫02z+z2zdz
e
2π∫02zz+94z2dz
